# Order Form TE-2026-004 under MSA v4

Customer: Tern Mobility · Term: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31

- Annual minimum commitment: $60,000.00, invoiced $15,000.00 quarterly in advance
  (January 1, April 1, July 1, October 1).
- Platform access for the full term. Each tracked event draws down the commitment at
  $0.10.
- Events above 600,000 in the term are invoiced monthly in arrears at $0.10.
- Unused commitment at the end of the term is not refunded and does not carry over.
